_doc: Games ESPN has not listed yet, keyed by the program's full name. where: H | A | N. Either `opp` (a full name), `opps` + `bracket` (day-2 of a 4-team bracket: winner plays winner, loser plays loser of the named pair), or `pool` (day-3 of an event: any team from the pool not already faced). Dates from the program's own release.
